description: Documented effective image preprocessing settings; the verification archive does not execute a raw-image training pipeline.

geometric_preprocessing.roi: Deterministic per-experiment and per-view crop; only the ROI heights required for the selected distance samples are supplied in this archive.

normalization.constant_source: Fixed ImageNet constants, not statistics fitted to the study images

rand_augment.operation_sampling: Uniform with replacement; two sequential draws; repeated operations and Identity are possible
rand_augment.probability_note: Theoretical selection probabilities from the implementation, not empirical frequencies measured in training logs

random_erasing.replacement_distribution: Independent standard-normal values within the sampled rectangle
random_erasing.p_note: 0.3 is the attempt probability; failure to find a valid rectangle can leave the image unchanged

training_augmentation.view_randomness: The same transform composition is invoked separately for side and top images; random parameters are not synchronized

implementation_version_evidence.meaning: Versions recorded in the original-environment verification records and inspected in the available environment; this archive does not replay historical training
implementation_version_evidence.package_runtime_requirement: Python 3.9+ standard library only; PyTorch and torchvision are not required to run the CSV/coordinate checks

configuration_wiring: The archived data-loader factory forwarded image size but used the transform function defaults for advanced augmentation and normalization; this specification documents effective behavior rather than assuming every YAML field was consumed.
historical_limit: Per-image augmentation draws were not recorded and are not reconstructed by this archive. Geometric RandAugment operations can alter spatial structure; no invariance guarantee is made.
